subject: Lovejoy formal Congress role
documented_finding: International Congress of Arts and Science programme lists Professor A. O. Lovejoy of Washington University as Secretary of Section A Metaphysics at 10 a.m.
evidence_limit: Does not establish duties beyond the printed office.

subject: Separate Philosophy of Religion section
documented_finding: The same programme schedules Philosophy of Religion at 3 p.m. and lists W. P. Montague rather than Lovejoy as secretary.
evidence_limit: Lovejoy's presence at or organization of the religion session is not established.

subject: Troeltsch names Marillier
documented_finding: Troeltsch's published paper says French psychology of religion approached complex facts more boldly and explicitly names Marillier Murisier and Flournoy as contributors who considerably aided the problem.
evidence_limit: Printed proximity within the Congress does not prove Lovejoy heard or read the passage.

subject: Comparative religion and India in adjacent section
documented_finding: Pfleiderer's philosophy-of-religion paper discusses historical comparison of religions Indian parallels Max Müller ethnology and analytical critical comparative method.
evidence_limit: Subject-matter overlap does not establish reception by Lovejoy.

subject: Same-day institutional proximity
documented_finding: Metaphysics and Philosophy of Religion were scheduled as distinct sections of the Department of Philosophy on the same day with Lovejoy formally attached to the former.
evidence_limit: Same-day scheduling establishes institutional proximity only not attendance or transmission.
